WeiDU could not install: {component}. The errors found are shown below.

This component is not installed. If you continue without it, the components that depend on it will be blocked.

Retry once the cause is fixed, continue without this component, pause the installation to examine the game, or stop it. To ask for help, export the diagnostic.

WeiDU.exe file not found in game folder.

A WeiDU.log file was detected in the game folder ({game_folder}).

This means the game has already been modded outside this application.

To continue, you must change the game installation folder or perform a clean game installation.
installation.warning_message:
Component {component} generated warnings.

What do you want to do?

Do you really want to cancel the installation?

This action is final. Installation will be abandoned and you will return to the first step.

Stop the installation after the current step?

WeiDU receives a stop request and finishes its work. If a component is interrupted in the middle of its installation, you will have to state its result when resuming.
